verdict.rationale: Stagehand's first-party docs describe giving a Claude Code agent persistent Stagehand browser tools over MCP/stdio. The integration exposes `run`, `snapshot`, and `screenshot` tools from a single server process that keeps page state across calls, and v3 docs also include a dedicated MCP integration section. A team-member HN comment confirms the Stagehand MCP server exists and won Anthropic's MCP hackathon. Missing for 10: detailed installation/configuration steps for the MCP server in the evidence, and independent (non-vendor) hands-on corroboration of connecting an agent through it.
